methodology: Codex independently reopened official manager and regulatory sources, extracted the decisive FERC PDFs at page level, checked acquisition and subsequent-exit evidence, recorded access behavior, and hashed retrieved bytes. Search results were used to locate direct evidence, not as final support.

verifiedClaims: The transaction was consummated on March 26, 2026.
Hill Top Energy Center became an indirect wholly owned subsidiary of Blackstone-affiliated funds.
A June 2026 filing continues to identify Hill Top as an indirect Blackstone subsidiary and wholly owned beneath the Blackstone aggregator.
The filing identifies 76.28% and 14.72% interests for the two named Blackstone vehicles.
FERC authorized the proposed Blackstone transaction on March 19, 2026.
The order supports the buyer-vehicle structure but is not itself evidence of consummation.
Ardian Americas Infrastructure Funds acquired 41.9% in July 2019 and the remaining interest in April 2025.
Ardian and Blackstone announced the definitive sale agreement on September 15, 2025.
The plant is a 620 MW gas-fired facility operating in PJM.
Ardian announced on April 28, 2025 that it acquired the remaining interest and reached 100% ownership.
The facility began operations in July 2021.
Blackstone announced its definitive agreement to acquire the 620 MW plant on September 15, 2025.
The announcement identifies Blackstone Energy Transition Partners as buyer strategy context but does not establish legal closing.

modelEvidenceCorrections.reason: The direct FERC consummation notice is the authoritative closing source and was made the sole primary in the accepted response.

modelEvidenceCorrections.claim: Blackstone's entry year is 2025 because the acquisition was announced then.
modelEvidenceCorrections.reason: The definitive agreement was announced in 2025, but the FERC notice establishes legal consummation on March 26, 2026.

exitSearchConclusion: No later sale, completed exit or signed pending ownership transfer of Hill Top was identified through 2026-08-15. The June 2026 regulatory filing continues to identify Hill Top as a Blackstone subsidiary.
